title: Implement RLS policies with FORCE on all tenant-scoped tables
acceptance_criteria: RLS enabled on all tenant-scoped tables: users, sessions, accounts, resumes, analyses, analysis_cache, ad_clicks
FORCE RLS policy applied: every row access checks current_setting('app.tenant_id')
Migration creates enable_rls SQL, policies, and app.tenant_id setting function
app.tenant_id is set on every database connection checkout in drizzle config
RLS policies do NOT apply to tenants table itself (it is cross-tenant)
Cross-tenant SELECT returns 0 rows (not error) due to RLS filtering
completion_summary: Created RLS migration (0001_rls_policies.sql) with FORCE policies on 8 tables (users, sessions, accounts, authenticators, resumes, analyses, analysis_cache, ad_clicks). Created helper functions set_tenant_context/clear_tenant_context/get_tenant_context. Updated lib/db/index.ts with getTenantDb(), getPooledTenantDb(), setTenantContext(), clearTenantContext().
